en: Habakkuk 1

p.src: 1  The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

en: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
u.src: 1  The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

zh: 哈巴谷為不公平而訴苦

p.src: 2  LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

ja: んでも、あなたはお聞きにならないのか。私が「暴虐だ」と叫んでも、
ってくださらないのか。
en: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
u.src: 2  LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

ja: 1:2 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 3  Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

ja: ておられるのか。破壊と
こり、いさかいが湧き上がる。
en: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
u.src: 3  Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

p.src: 4  Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

en: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
u.src: 4  Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

p.src: 5  “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

ja: げられても、あなたがたは
en: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
u.src: 5  “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

p.src: 6  For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

en: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
u.src: 6  For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

ja: 1:6 「見よ」と訳されたヘブル語は、見る、注意を向ける、よく観察するという意味を持ち、しばしば強い呼びかけとして用いられる。
en: 1:6 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 7  They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

ja: ろしく、畏怖を起こす。その
en: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
u.src: 7  They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

p.src: 8  Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

ja: より獰猛だ。その騎兵は猛然と駆け進む。
en: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
u.src: 8  Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

p.src: 9  All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

ja: る。その大軍はひたすら
en: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.
u.src: 9  All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

p.src: 10  Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

en: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.
u.src: 10  Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

p.src: 11  Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

ja: とする彼らは、まことに罪ある者だ。」
en: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
u.src: 11  Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

zh: 哈巴谷又向耶和華訴苦

p.src: 12  Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

ja: からおられる方ではないか。われわれは
きのために彼らを立てられた。
らしめるためにこの者を据えられた。
en: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
u.src: 12  Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

ja: 1:12 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 1:12 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 13  You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

ja: るに耐えず、よこしまを黙って
ごされない。それなのに、なぜ
en: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
u.src: 13  You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

p.src: 14  and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

ja: うもののようにされるのか。
en: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
u.src: 14  and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

p.src: 15  He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

en: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
u.src: 15  He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

p.src: 16  Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

ja: をたく。それらによってぜいたくに暮らし、
en: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
u.src: 16  Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

p.src: 17  Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

en: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
u.src: 17  Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
